text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting modest losses, with Ethereum's 3.2% decline outpacing Bitcoin's 1.2%, suggesting selective weakness in altcoins and DeFi exposure. The Fear & Greed Index at 28 reflects genuine caution, though the slight 7-day improvement hints the selloff may be stabilizing rather than accelerating. Bitcoin's rising dominance to 56.8% combined with $61B in volume indicates capital is rotating toward the safer major rather than fleeing crypto entirely.
